_notes: Canonical MCP server config for stromy-plugin. Edit only this file. Run scripts/render-mcp.py to regenerate .mcp.json / .gemini/settings.json / .codex/config.toml / .vscode/mcp.json.

nl-gov-data._notes: Dutch government open-data MCP — search/fetch legislation, parliamentary records, Rijksoverheid documents, plus the intel/analysis skills (nl-gov-data, nl-tensions, nl-policy-legislative-landscape, nl-parliamentary-positioning, nl-issue-framing, nl-gov-shared). Per-user OAuth via Microsoft Entra ID. Composes with stromy-format for rendering — see infra-docs/ai/three-layer-tooling.md.

stromy-format._notes: Hosted format skills (format-pptx, format-pptx-hd, format-docx, format-pdf, format-pdf-hd, format-xlsx, format-mermaid, format-diagram, format-chart, format-remotion-video). Fetched at runtime via fs_read — see skills/<name>/SKILL.md stubs.

asset-broker._notes: Authenticated client-asset broker — propose reviewed website/brand edits as GitHub PRs (asset-editor skill, fetched via fs_read). Per-user OAuth via Microsoft Entra ID. This is the operator master surface: with the Entra `operator` role the caller is unrestricted and can edit any client-data folder or website for testing — reach is bounded only by where the stromy-asset-broker GitHub App is installed (client-data + every *-website repo). Every non-operator caller stays scoped to their own client.<slug>(s).

apify._notes: Official Apify MCP (BYOK). The subprocess env var the server reads is APIFY_TOKEN; its value is sourced from the operator's existing ${APIFY_API_TOKEN} (the org's one Apify token, also used by lead-scout) so no second secret is maintained. The token authorizes actor runs billed to the client's Apify account and goes client → Apify directly through the local subprocess, never transiting Stromy infra. Drives the research-apify skill (web search/crawl/extract → standard envelope → format-* handoff). CODEX CAVEAT: render-mcp.py strips placeholder env refs (dollar-brace form) for Codex (it would pass them literally), so under Codex the subprocess inherits the shell env — APIFY_TOKEN (the name the server reads) must be exported there; the APIFY_API_TOKEN mapping only reaches Claude/Gemini/VS Code. Hosted https://mcp.apify.com is valid for OAuth, but hosted bearer mode needs renderer support for safe prefixed Authorization headers before it can be the BYOK default.
